subject: Personnel evidence request: onboarding/offboarding controls for SOC2 pre-assessment
messages:
From: BrightLane Audit Team <audit@brightlane.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightlane.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel onboarding & offboarding evidence for SOC2 pre-assessment

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off the scoping for BrightLane's SOC2 pre-assessment and need a set of personnel controls artifacts from Redwood Inference to validate onboarding/offboarding and training controls. Can you provide the following by EOD 2027-09-10? If you need more time, let us know: 

- Training completion roster for all employees (past 12 months) with completion dates and course IDs (redacted PII is fine).
- Background check evidence: vendor name, sample redacted reports (5 samples), and a log showing completed checks with timestamps.
- Onboarding checklist template and a sample completed checklist for 3 recent hires.
- Offboarding/deprovisioning timeline for 3 recent leavers (timestamped IAM events if possible).
- Policy references (links or PDFs) for background checks and training retention/recordkeeping.

Preferred delivery: secure link to a shared drive or SFTP; if you have a SOC2 evidence kit or compliance bundle we can review that instead. Please indicate your point of contact for this.

Thanks,
Dana Lee
Senior Auditor, BrightLane Audit Team
audit@brightlane.com

--
Attachment request: Please mark any artifacts with redactions applied (e.g., name -> user-###).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: BrightLane Audit Team <audit@brightlane.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel onboarding & offboarding evidence for SOC2 pre-assessment

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the clear list — we can assemble this. Quick clarifying questions so we scope the packet correctly:

1) Sample size — you requested 5 redacted background reports and 3 hires/leavers. Is that preferred for reviewers, or would you like a larger sample across roles (engineering, sales, infra)?
2) Redaction level — we typically redact PII (names -> user-###, SSNs fully redacted). Is that acceptable?
3) Timeframe — do you want training completions for the past 12 months or a rolling 24 months?

We have an internal evidence packing template and can push the artifacts to a secure Drive folder. I'll coordinate with Priyom (infra) to pull IAM removal events and with Soojin (HR) for training & BG checks.

I'll attach a brief inventory spreadsheet listing artifacts and who owns each item (will send in follow-up).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Marissa / Priyom —

Following up with the initial items we can provide quickly. I've pulled together what HR can own immediately:

- training_roster_Q1-3-2027.csv (contains employee id, role, course_id, completion_date) — PII redacted where required; retention policy column included.
- bg_check_logs_redacted.pdf (5 sample reports redacted, plus a CSV log vended by ClearCheck showing checks and timestamps) — vendor: ClearCheck Solutions.
- onboard_checklist_v3.pdf (current template + one completed sample for 2027-07 hire).
- deprovision_runbook.md (internal runbook describing IAM steps; sensitive commands removed in redacted version).

Notes / controls:
- Background checks are vendor-managed; we retain vendor logs for 5 years per policy.
- Training completions are retained in LMS (SecureLearn); we export CSVs on request.

I'll upload these to the Drive folder and flag anything with Personally Identifiable Information. Priyom — can you pull the IAM deletion logs for the three leavers: user-232, user-447, user-559 (dates provided in the spreadsheet)? BrightLane requested timestamped events; we can provide the event_ids and timestamps from the IAM audit trail.

I'll attach the inventory spreadsheet in the next email.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
HR Business Partner — Security & Ops

Hi Marissa and team,

Appreciate the quick responses and the artifact list. Two follow-ups from the audit team:

1) For IAM events, could you include the raw event IDs and make sure timestamps are in UTC? We will request a sample of 5 user removals across the last 12 months — 3 you've listed are fine; please add two more if available.
2) Please provide a short narrative (1 page) explaining your background check vendor workflow (how vendor receives candidate data, verification checks performed, retention and deletion policy).

Deadline update: if you need an extra few days to pull IAM events, we can accept delivery by 2027-09-15. Please confirm.

Thanks,
Dana Lee
Senior Auditor, BrightLane
